notes:
Zaiqa Billing, Zaiqa Waiter, Zaiqa Kitchen, Zaiqa Stock and Zaiqa Staff apps, version 2.36.1.

Staff app: mistaken check-out, statement visibility, security deposit
- Check-out now asks "Are you sure?". If it was a mistake, the employee taps "Checked out by mistake? Ask the owner"; once the owner approves, the check-out is removed and the shift continues.
- Per employee (Staff App → Staff & phones → Edit): salary statement visible "always" or only in the last 7 days of the month (default).
- New 🔒 Security button per employee: add security money (cash given, or taken from this month's salary) or give it back. The employee sees the balance in the Money tab; it is not part of salary.
